description:

While Detective Garry McFadden is the middle of training a new female homicide detective, the two are assigned to investigate the murder of a woman found wrapped up in a blanket.

title: I Am Homicide
description:
S02 E08 — The Long Night
When Detective Garry McFadden agrees to do a favor for a witness, he finds himself involved in a strange murder investigation that plays out over one of the longest nights of his career, leading to an unexpected killer.

title: Suspicious Minds
description:
S01 E01 — Chi Town Gossip
The brutal murder of a successful hair salon owner and mother upends a tight-knit Chicago community; while neighbors whisper about the killer's identity, detectives must break down walls of silence and uncover the plot to slay this local icon.

title: Suspicious Minds
description:
S01 E02 — In Case of Murder
The untimely death of Melissa Henderson, wife and mother of two, rattles a small Indiana town, but revelations of foul play at her funeral set the rumor mill ablaze; local gossip leads investigators to a riverboat casino, with unexpected suspects.

title: Suspicious Minds
description:
S01 E05 — Everyone Knows Her Name
After the shocking death of Heather Maples, the student community of Murfreesboro confronts the sobering truth that a killer is lurking among them; detectives unlock her cellphone to find a web of potential suspects and retrace her last night alive.

title: Someone You Thought You Knew
description:
S02 E01 — The Body on Bowden Road
Stephanie Shea Graham, 20, is found murdered on a desolate road; detectives gather clues and question suspects, and when the truth is finally revealed, the identity of her killer will prove to be more shocking than ever imagined.

title: Someone You Thought You Knew
description:
S02 E03 — Maine Murder Mystery
In Webster Plantation, Maine, Mike and Valerie Miller are found shot dead in their own home, and authorities must consider a list of suspects that includes their own family members.

title: Someone You Thought You Knew
description:
S02 E06 — Nightmare on Oak Hollow Drive
Etta Jean Westbrook is a longtime resident of a quiet suburb in Bryan, Texas; when she is found murdered inside her home, detectives question her loved ones and canvass the neighborhood in order to catch the killer.

title: Someone You Thought You Knew
description:
S02 E04 — Evil in Idaho
No one hears from Lisa Stukey for weeks, and her decomposing body is found inside her Idaho Falls, Idaho, home; police realize Stukey has been beaten to death and set out to catch the culprit who has ties to the victim.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S10 E02 — HOA Hellfire
When a resident revives an HOA to beautify her community, some neighbors are unhappy, believing the organization is fraudulent; tensions escalate when liens are placed on the house of a couple unwilling to pay, ending in a suburban shootout.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S10 E05 — Road to Ruin
Friendly neighbors on a peaceful street have their lives disrupted when a developer moves in and builds houses nearby; tempers flare over the access road he uses for heavy equipment, which fuels escalating threats and confrontations.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S09 E01 — The Secret Wife
A peaceful suburb turns upside down when a family learns that the neighbor has kept a secret wife locked in his home for years; things escalate when the family helps her escape with her baby, leading to a bitter feud that ends in terrible bloodshed.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S09 E04 — Commanded to Kill
The paranoid delusions of one young man compel him to conspire against the unwitting family next door; over a series of months, his deteriorating mental condition escalates into a midnight shooting, which shakes the foundation of the neighborhood.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S10 E06 — Intimidation Tactics
A mother and daughter upscale their lives when they move into a beautiful suburban community; their next door neighbor takes an instant dislike to them and tensions rise until a vicious murder is caught on home video.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S09 E05 — Full Frontal Attack
A family lends a friend a place to stay but kicks her out after a blow-up; instead of moving away, she buys a house across the street, kicking off a years-long dispute ending in a hail of bullets, blood, death, and a community in shock.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S07 E11 — Philly Fallout
The building of a backyard shed destroys a years-long, close relationship between two neighbors and ignites a vicious conflict that sees property destroyed, pets killed, and finally two people shot to death in cold blood.

title: A Deadly Deal
description: A long-simmering feud between a man and his stepfather reignites under one roof. As property disputes, accusations, and daily conflicts escalate, a family home becomes a battleground where rising tensions threaten to end in tragedy.

title: Game Day Murders
description:
S01 E06 — Blindsided By Tragedy
A deadly home invasion claims the life of Washington Redskins safety Sean Taylor, leading many to wonder if it was an obsessed fan, a targeted hit, or an inside job; after media speculation runs wild, an anonymous tip reveals the truth.

title: Murder in the Heartland
description:
S02 E01 — Branches of Evil

description:

A 33-year-old single mother, Lindsey Wilkins is found shot in the head by an apparent suicide, but when no gun is found, police suspect murder and uncover a trail of secrets and betrayals with a shocking twist puts the case in jeopardy.

title: Dead Reckoning
description:
S01 E05 — Online Secrets
In 2014, the scorched remains of a house fire reveal two female victims, Robin Aldridge, 58, and her daughter, Mani, 17; when investigators dig deeper into the women's lives, they uncover a secret online relationship that led to tragedy.

title: Dead Reckoning
description:
S01 E01 — Murder in the Park
Nineteen-year-old single mother Cheyenne Clough is brutally assaulted and left in a secluded park to die; as police investigate, they discover a trail of blind loyalty and deadly betrayal that may have led to her murder.

title: Your Worst Nightmare
description:
S06 E01 — No End In Sight
Debbie Puglisi is enjoying life with her husband in their new dream home, but when an unexpected visitor drops by the neighborhood, Debbie's whole world becomes a nightmare.

title: Your Worst Nightmare
description:
S06 E03 — The Watcher
Single mom Carrie Caudill and a friend embark on a girls' night out, but an unexpected confrontation puts Carrie on a dangerous collision course with a sadistic madman.

title: Your Worst Nightmare
description:
S06 E07 — The Night Shift
Single mother Barbara Nunn relocates to Florida, but she struggles to find her way; after she lands a job at a local diner, it appears her troubles are finally behind her; one night, a surprise confrontation with customers ends in murder.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:

A man crashes into the back of a woman's vehicle; officers respond to the scene only to find her car abandoned; witnesses point to the other driver, and detectives are horrified to discover a sadistic psychopath who admits to murder.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S04 E06 — I Was a Star
A woman dies in a brutal stabbing at home; police quickly locate the prime suspect, her ex-boyfriend Antoine Bynum; in his interrogation, he appears to have a psychotic episode until detectives discover it's merely the ruse of a deranged psychopath.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S04 E03 — God Was Going to Use Me
A longtime nurse confesses to helping end the lives of numerous elderly patients at multiple nursing homes; detectives discover this is no angel of mercy; behind her unsuspecting persona lies a ruthless psychopath.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:

The Tourniquet Killer terrorizes young girls across Houston, Texas, and when advances in DNA finally lead to his arrest, this psychopath eagerly confesses to multiple murders; weeks before his execution, he grants one interview in the spotlight.

title: Evil Lives Here: The Killer Speaks
description:

Elisabeth and Frank reconnect after years apart, and Elisabeth's mother, Cheri, watches as their toxic relationship blows up and leads to a devastating fire; when the smoke clears, one lies dead, and the other sits behind bars.

title: Evil Lives Here: The Killer Speaks
description:

During the day, Lorenzo Gilyard is a soft-spoken and well-liked man, but at night, he's a monster, preying on women; his best friend, a trained social worker, misses the signs; going inside the prison to get answers from the notorious serial killer.

title: Evil Lives Here: The Killer Speaks

Patrick Piddock knows there's something dark inside him, and his daughter, Fawn, and those around him suffer from his sudden outbursts; he's warned that one day he'll kill someone, but no one knows how dangerous he is until he takes a life.

At a family-run construction company, brothers and cousins work hard and play even harder; then, one of them goes missing, but no one steps forward with answers; the man's disappearance remains a mystery for 20 years.
